issue_context.title: posix: implement `putmsg()`
issue_context.body:
This is part of the See [POSIX Roadmap for LTSv3](https://github.com/zephyrproject-rtos/zephyr/issues/51211) (RFC #51211).

`putmsg()` is required as part of `_XOPEN_STREAMS` Option Group.

For more information, please refer to https://pubs.opengroup.org/onlinepubs/9699919799/functions/putmsg.html

As in other tests, if we are not linking POSIX objects, then we expect that there is no symbol that can be resolved for `putmsg`. However, users should still be able to include the header (and likely see some relevant bits).

```
/opt/toolchains/zephyr-sdk-0.16.4/arc-zephyr-elf/bin/../lib/gcc/arc-zephyr-elf/12.2.0/../../../../arc-zephyr-elf/bin/ld.bfd: /__w/zephyr/zephyr/tests/posix/headers/src/stropts_h.c:10: undefined reference to `putmsg'
```

So it only makes sense to assert that the symbol exists when we build that source.

```suggestion
#ifdef CONFIG_POSIX_API
	zassert_not_null((void *)putmsg, "putmsg is null");
#endif
```
